title: test(devx): a clocked test whose first served view read cold-loads the lint package root can time out under shard load; find and warm the rest of the population
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt

立卡门: ① 已交付工作欠的后续。PR #29622(#29603)合约复审 6590167086 的开放问题，席位裁 B:同类慢测今天就能列出，不等第二次变红再立卡。
业务理由: `main` 的测试清单偶发变红会挡住所有席位的 PR 合并(常设裁定「平台测试清单反复变红，肯定要修啊」)。#29603 实测：第一次读视图时冷加载 lint 包根，在 vitest 里要 1.2–1.7 秒，全落在 5 秒的单例计时里；分片负载一高就超时。同样的冷加载可能还藏在别的计时用例里。
动手的读者: domain:devx(测试基础设施)。按 #29622 的做法(模块顶部预载 lint 包根 + `check:test-source-alias` 要求的锚定源别名)处理名单里实测确有冷加载的文件，或者在共享 harness 里统一预载。
查重: `loadFormLayoutLint cold`、`first view read timeout lint`:只命中 #29603 / PR #29622。

Follow-up of: #29603 (PR #29622)

## What is known
- `getMetaItem` wraps every served exit in `serveFormLayout` → `withFormLayoutWarnings`. That awaits `loadFormLayoutLint()` (`formLayoutLint ??= import('@objectstack/lint')`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/metadata-diagnostics.ts`). In tests where metadata-protocol resolves to dist, the first served view read per process cold-transforms the lint graph inside the clocked case.
- `check:test-source-alias` cannot follow a load inside another package's code. Its header says widening the population is a different card: this one.
- Candidate population, from a coarse grep (test files that build the real protocol and read a view by name, minus files that already preload the lint root). These are candidates, not findings:
  - runtime: `src/package-revert-stored-members.integration.test.ts`, `src/domains/meta-save-preconditions-parity.test.ts` (the #24395 cases at the default budget), and possibly `src/domains/packages-seed-apply-org-scope.test.ts` (its miss path is not traced).
  - metadata-protocol: 13 files; objectql: 6 files. The list is in contract review 6590167086.

## Wanted
- Measure each candidate's first view-read case: p50/max over repeats, idle and under contention. Keep only the files whose clocked case carries the cold load.
- Warm them the #29622 way, or in a shared harness if more than a few files need it. ⛔ No raised timeout without naming the cost, no retry, no skip, no weakened assertion.
- Optional: a gate arm that names a clocked case whose first served read reaches `loadFormLayoutLint` without a preload, if one can be made cheaply. Otherwise say why not.
- Product code is out of scope. The lazy import keeps the lint root off the boot path by design.
